# Tapsan Mökit

Holiday rentals near Jyväskylä, Central Finland, rented directly by the owner, Tapani Nieminen.
Phone +358 400 244 406, tapani.nieminen@tapsanmokit.com. Site: https://tapsanmokit.com (English: /en)

## Huvila Uurainen (villa)
Täkylahdentie 42 B, 41230 Uurainen, on Lake Iso-Uurainen (2 x 5 km). Fireplace room, sauna, glazed terrace,
kitchen, 3 bedrooms, alcove, balcony; upstairs can be set up for meetings. Shallow east-facing shore, about 1 m
deep 20 m out. Prices from (1-4 guests): 1 night weekdays 285 EUR, Mon-Fri 870 EUR, Fri-Sun 650 EUR,
week Sun-Sun 1280 EUR. https://tapsanmokit.com/huvila-uurainen

## Mökki Jyväskylä (round-log cottage)
Sikomäentie 365, 41140 Kuikka, Jyväskylä, on a pond with no other cottages. Kitchen-living room, loft, balcony,
porch, sleeps 4+2; sauna, shower and toilet; enclosed grill hut with kota kitchen (17 m2); guest house with
4+2 beds; boat; road to the door. Prices from (1-4 guests): 1 night weekdays 140 EUR, Mon-Fri 420 EUR,
Fri-Sun 390 EUR, week Sun-Sun 530 EUR. https://tapsanmokit.com/mokki-jyvaskyla

## Huoneisto Tikkakoski (apartment)
Tikkakoskentie 527, 41140 Kuikka, Tikkakoski, Jyväskylä. Sleeps 5 (double bed, twin room, single room).
Kitchen, TV, desk, own sauna with always-ready Harvia stove. Jyväskylä centre 18 km, airport 4 km.
From 135 EUR a night (1-3 guests). https://tapsanmokit.com/huoneisto-tikkakoski

## Hot tub rental (kylpytynnyri)
Mobile hot tub on a trailer, Jyväskylä. 80 EUR a day on weekdays, 140 EUR a day at weekends. Pick-up or
delivery, always cleaned, open to everyone. https://tapsanmokit.com/kylpytynnyri
